## Summary
Ariyan Khan is a professional freelance video editor helping YouTube creators, brands, founders, coaches, educators, and agencies grow through high-retention video content. He specializes in four core areas: talking head YouTube videos, cinematic documentaries, short-form social content (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts), and animated map/geopolitical visuals. With 5M+ total views generated for clients, 314+ satisfied clients worldwide, and an average 60%+ audience retention rate on edited videos, Ariyan delivers broadcast-quality work with a standard 48-hour turnaround.

- Documentary-style talking head edits for YouTube and social media
- Includes: B-roll integration, animated captions, motion graphics, sound design, color grading
- Best for: YouTube creators, coaches, educators, founders, personal brands
- Typical turnaround: 48 hours
- URL: https://ariyankhan.com/talking-head-video-editing.html

- Professional long-form documentary editing with cinematic quality

- Best for: Documentary filmmakers, history channels, educational content, broadcast
- Typical turnaround: 3-5 days

- URL: https://ariyankhan.com/documentary-video-editing.html

## Tools & Software
- Primary: Adobe Premiere Pro
- Color Grading: DaVinci Resolve
- Motion Graphics: Adobe After Effects
- Audio: Adobe Audition, Premiere Pro audio tools

## Editing Process
1. The Brief — Understanding your vision, audience, and goals. A clear brief is written before editing begins.
2. Rough Cut — Building the story structure, finding the strongest moments, setting pacing and narrative flow.
3. Fine Cut + Graphics — Precision editing with motion graphics, captions, B-roll, lower thirds, and transitions.
4. Color + Audio — Cinematic color grading, professional audio mix, noise reduction, and music.
5. Delivery + Revisions — Export in required format, platform-optimized. 2 revision rounds included. Source files available on request.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Can I request revisions?
Yes! Every project includes 2 rounds of free revisions to ensure the final output meets your exact vision. Additional revision rounds are available for a small fee.

### What is your delivery time?
Delivery time depends on the length and complexity of your footage. Short-form and talking-head edits are usually faster (24-48h), while documentaries may take 3-5 days. Timeline is always discussed before starting.

### Can you match my existing editing style?
Absolutely. Send a reference video and Ariyan will analyze and replicate the color grade, pacing, motion graphics, and overall feel to maintain consistency with your channel's brand.

### Do you provide source files?
Yes, Adobe Premiere Pro project files are available upon request for an additional fee. Final video is delivered in any required format — 4K, 1080p, vertical (9:16), square, or custom aspect ratios.

### How do I get started?
Fill out the contact form at https://ariyankhan.com/#contact with your project details. Ariyan responds within 1 hour to discuss scope, timeline, pricing, and next steps.
